definitions.explanation: The highness or lowness of a sound, especially in terms of accuracy when singing or playing an instrument.
The distance in pitch between two notes.

{音程|おんてい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{外|はず}れている→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧。
⟦カラオケ→カラオケ：05080_karaoke⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{音程|おんてい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are songs where it's hard to hit the right pitch at karaoke.
The interval between these two notes is a third.

notes:
MUSICAL INTERVALS:
- ⟦{長|ちょう}→〜長：04665_chou⟧2⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧ (major second)
- ⟦{短|たん}→短〜：03959_tan⟧3⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧ (minor third)
- ⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧5⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧ (perfect fifth)
- オクターブ (octave)

RELATED MUSICAL TERMS:
- ⟦{音階|おんかい}→音階：04903_onkai⟧ (musical scale)
- ⟦{音符|おんぷ}→音符：06988_onpu⟧ (musical note)
- {調|ちょう} (key, tonality)
- ⟦{和音|わおん}→和音：04751_waon⟧ (chord)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {音程|おんてい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}っている→合う：10466_au⟧ (pitch is correct)
- {音程|おんてい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{外|はず}れる→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧ (to be off-pitch)
- {音程|おんてい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to hit the right pitch)
- {音程|おんてい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{不安定|ふあんてい}→不安定：11318_fuantei⟧ (pitch is unstable)

NOTE: For absolute pitch (the ability to identify or produce any pitch without reference), Japanese uses {絶対音感|ぜったいおんかん}.
